title: SnowDays: Ice Magic at Lake Louise

title: 🎃 Ghouls' Night Out
description: Family Halloween event in the historic village: a Halloween maze, crafts, live Halloween theatre and characters. Oct 23–24, 5–9 pm, and Oct 25, 3–7 pm at Heritage Park Historical Village, 1900 Heritage Dr SW. Cost: Adults 16+ $24.95 + GST; kids 3-15 $18.95 + GST (prices from Daily Hive; check at booking).

title: 🎃 Boo Bash (ages 0-6)
description: A gentle morning for the littlest ghosts, with crafts, games, a play zone and indoor trick-or-treating. 10 am-2 pm at SLS Centre. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Trunk or Treat
description: Kids collect treats from decorated cars and play Halloween games, a safe and easy way to trick-or-treat. 5-8 pm at SLS Centre. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Kids Halloween Howler
description: A costume dance party just for kids. Bring your ghosts, goblins and superheroes to the dance floor. 6:30-9 pm at Turner Valley Legion, 121 Sunset Blvd E. Cost: Not listed.

title: 🎃 Halloween Howl
description: An old-fashioned country Halloween with a potluck, pumpkin carving contest, haunted house and costume parade. 6-10 pm at Millarville Racing & Agricultural Society Hall, 306097 192 St W. Cost: Not listed (potluck).

title: 🎃 Banff Halloween: Echoes of the Forest
description: Hot apple cider, spooky stories by the fire, crafts and library storytimes in the park. 1-4 pm (library storytimes 1:30, 2:15, 3 pm) at Okâch – Îyethkabi Oûgitûbi pavilion, Sundance Park. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Mini Pumpkin Painting (ages 11-14)
description: A cozy creative night for tweens painting their own mini pumpkins. 6-7:15 pm at Okotoks Public Library, 23 Riverside Dr. Cost: Free, registration required. Full, waitlist full.

title: 🎃 Family Halloween Boogie
description: A family costume dance with a photo booth, crafts, a costume contest and an indoor trick-or-treat trail. 5:30 pm at Town Hall, 309B Macleod Trail SW. Cost: Not listed (food bank / Jumpstart donations encouraged).

title: 🎃 Trick or Treat in Historic Downtown Cochrane
description: Stroll downtown in costume and collect treats at local shops that have balloons out front. 12-4 pm at Participating businesses, Historic Downtown. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Trunk or Treat (Lions Club of Canmore)
description: Daytime trick-or-treating from trunk to trunk, all in one walkable spot. 11 am-2 pm at The Beat at Spring Creek, Spring Creek Dr. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Halloween Hangout (Movie + More), Teens only (ages 13-17)
description: Teens only (ages 13-17). A laid-back Halloween movie afternoon with a selfie station for teens who've outgrown trick-or-treating. 1:30-4 pm at Okotoks Public Library, 23 Riverside Dr. Cost: Free, drop-in.

title: 🎃 ZooBOO
description: Kids trick-or-treat at stations around the zoo, colour a giant monster mural and visit the animals. 9 am-5:30 pm (per ToDo Canada) at Calgary Zoo, 210 St. George's Dr NE. Cost: Included with zoo admission or membership.

title: 🎃 Harvest Pumpkin Fest at Butterfield Acres
description: Pick a pumpkin in the farmyard, visit the animals, ride a wagon through Scarecrow Alley and warm up by the firepits. Weekends only: Oct 17, 18, 24, 25 and 31. Tickets are for a 2-hour time slot and must be bought online ahead (no drop-ins). Morning tickets have an option for a pumpkin hunt for little ones. At 254077 Rocky Ridge Rd NW. Cost: Kids (walking to 17) $16.99 + GST; adults $19.99 + GST; pony rides and wagon rides extra; pumpkins sold separately.

title: 🎃 Pumpkin Palooza at Cobb's Adventure Park
description: Walk the pumpkin patch, snap fall photos and pick a pumpkin to carve, plus the kangaroo petting zoo, fence maze and giant slides. Pumpkin Palooza runs Saturdays and Sundays, 11 am-5 pm, through Oct 25 at 1500 84 St NE. Cost: Day pass $21.95 + GST online (plus $1.95 ticket fee); kids 2 and under free.

title: 🎃 Fall Days at Calgary Farmyard
description: Pick your pumpkin, wander the corn maze, take a wagon ride and meet the farm animals. Open Fri-Sun from 10 am through Oct 25 (Fri/Sat until 9:30 pm with Harvest Lights; Sun until 5 pm). At 284022 Township Rd 224. Cost: $25.95 + GST online; tickets are date-specific.

title: 🎃 Pumpkin Hunt
description: Search for wooden pumpkins hung in the trees around Millennium Park and the west end of the Friendship Trail. Daily, all day, Oct 8-31. Cost: Free.

title: 🎃 Western Foothills Pumpkin Derby
description: Pumpkin racing fun for the whole family; costumes encouraged. 10 am-1 pm (judging starts at 11, racing at noon) at Sheep River Library, 129 Main St NW. Cost: Free (pre-register Oct 1-22 to guarantee a spot).

title: 🎃 Pumpkin Racer Decoration Meet-Up
description: Get your pumpkin racer ready for the Pumpkin Derby: decorate it together with other families. 1-4 pm at Sheep River Library, rooms 3 and 4, 129 Main St NW. Cost: Free, pumpkins provided; optional wheel sets $10. Registration closed Oct 12; call the library to check for spots.

title: 🎃 Family Pumpkin Carving
description: Carve a pumpkin together as a family in 30-minute slots. 1-3:30 pm at High River Library, WO Mitchell Room, 909 1 St SW. Cost: Free. Registration required, spots limited.

title: 🎃 Drive-In Movie on the Elevator: The Witches (PG)
description: Watch The Witches (PG) projected on the grain elevator from your car. 7-9 pm at Canadian Grain Elevator Discovery Centre, 2119 19 Ave. Cost: $40 per vehicle (about $42.48 with Showpass fees).
